activeSameOriginHTML.detail: An inline script inside the loaded same-origin iframe can access the parent document before DOM transplantation. Trust boundary exists regardless of selector guard.

focusOnReplacedNode.detail: The replaced focused element is removed; focus requires application-level management.

duplicateIDs.detail: First matched target is replaced; duplicate IDs remain ambiguous.

cspInlineHandler.detail: Inline iframe onload is blocked by strict script-src self policy without unsafe-inline, nonce or hash.
